## Body

Lost or late FINALs (F260):
- A Copilot seat's native receiver lapses about 8 h after start (the Entra loss): the managed-extension policy flips Allowed -> Pending and the pij extension is force-killed, with no session.error.
- Sends to it are then REFUSED with "native-extension-unavailable" and lost. The OMP pij_send tool printed "queued" anyway (index.ts drops outcome).
- Check with: sqlite3 -readonly ~/.pij-rs/pij.sqlite "select ... from spine_events where payload like '%<msgid>%'".
- If a coder says "FINAL sent" and you never saw it, freeze and route at once.
- Fixes in flight: F260 (nightingale: park and redeliver on renewal; Held receipt) and F261/#311 (falcon: a lapse edge auto-restarts a live Copilot seat).
- Some FINALs simply arrive late (marten's #310 R2 came about 5 min after its head); don't log them as lost until the spine says refused.

OMP coders in their own worktree (#304, live):
- Create the worktree yourself: git -C ~/pi-hacking/pij worktree add ~/pi-hacking/pij-<item> -b <branch> origin/main.
- Then: pij-rs --json spawn --harness omp --role worker --cwd <worktree>. Its extension_path is <wt>/.omp/extensions/pij.
- Review seats stay COPILOT, never OMP, in PR worktrees (S304-N001: OMP loads the PR's .omp code).

Disk floor:
- shared-build refuses below 25 GiB free. The prime ruled the floor STAYS (it's a brake).
- Fix by deleting only pij's own rebuildable target/ dirs, after checks: lsof -d cwd for processes inside, and pij-rs list folders for seats.
- I freed 26 GiB (13 dirs, all logged in LOG.md). Skip pij-omp-cache and copilot-ttl-proxy (pm-004's) until outstanding-silkworm agrees. Most of the volume isn't pij's (Jordan).

Security seats:
- Always Claude (claude-opus-5.5); GPT seats hit the safeguard 422 (D-SEC-1).
- Copilot GPT seats report "memory votes unavailable": that is harmless.

Cost: the high machine launch rate (284-648/s) was OSK's pij-melted-mole test run, not ours. The PA attributes by pane tree.
